capabilities: close the window when the last note is closed
keep the app running on macOS after window close
quit the application on Windows and Linux after window close
disambiguation: Not a tab-management or workspace plugin; it only closes the window once its last note is closed.
extras: The README includes a Dev section with build commands, but no screenshots or troubleshooting guidance.
intentEvidence: in order to match how tabs in browsers work
motivation: To make Obsidian's window behavior match how tabs in browsers work.
problem: Obsidian keeps an empty window open after all notes are closed, unlike browsers which close the window.
summary: Window behavior plugin that closes the Obsidian window when the last note is closed, mimicking browser tab behavior.
